description: Recommend ungate / arbitrage / avoid for an ASIN, with a 3-bullet rationale citing named metrics (gating_score, amz_retail_dominance_pct, fba_pct, brand_posture). Also returns the ASIN's product brand, title and price (or price range) plus fulfillment (FBA/FBM/Amazon). Use for 'should I try to ungate this?' / 'how should I price this?'.

marketplace_id.description: 1 = Amazon UK, 2 = Amazon US (default), 4 = Amazon CA, 5 = Amazon AU, 6 = Amazon DE, 7 = Amazon JP, 8 = Amazon IT, 9 = Amazon FR, 10 = Amazon ES, 11 = Amazon MX, 12 = Amazon BR. Amazon only.
